name: codex-auto-pilot
description: Deliver approved plans through verified PR and release stages with canonical release notes.

interface.shortDescription: Build a verified PR and close releases with notes
interface.longDescription: Uses one controller, one declared accountable implementation lane, optional bounded helpers, one compact handoff, and an optional ship lane that starts a separate fresh release task after PR readiness. Released runs require canonical notes and a final linked release message; local worktree removal remains explicit and safety-checked.
defaultPrompt: $auto-pilot pr <approved-plan-path>. Use ship instead when I explicitly want Auto Pilot to create a fresh release task immediately after the PR becomes ready.
